overview: This enum chooses a character-specific pain voice that can replace the normal damage voice.

None.technical: None selects the normal damage-voice path. ActionController_PlayDamageVoice uses voice id 6 with the ordinary EGameCharacterDamageVoiceType, and returns without playback when that type is also None. DamageVoiceTimer greater than zero forces the same path even when another special value is supplied.

THUNDER.technical: THUNDER is the special-damage voice selector. When the owner DamageVoiceTimer is not positive, ActionController_PlayDamageVoice sends voice id 7 and this value to GAISlot186. PlayVoice case 7 reads Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_SpecialDamage and indexes Id_VoiceGroup at value minus one. The matching exported slot carries the THUNDER name.

RESTRAINT.simple: Play the pain voice for being restrained.
RESTRAINT.technical: RESTRAINT is the special-damage voice selector. When the owner DamageVoiceTimer is not positive, ActionController_PlayDamageVoice sends voice id 7 and this value to GAISlot186. PlayVoice case 7 reads Id_CharacterVoiceGroup_SpecialDamage and indexes Id_VoiceGroup at value minus one. The throwing restraint action calls this value directly.

Invalid.simple: An invalid special pain voice choice.
Invalid.technical: Invalid is declared as the 255 sentinel. The dispatcher only excludes None, so an assigned Invalid would still be cast to a byte and passed to PlayVoice, which indexes the SpecialDamage voice array without an upper bound check. No traced source caller assigns Invalid.

notes: The special voice replaces the ordinary voice only while DamageVoiceTimer is not positive. A positive timer keeps the ordinary damage voice.
PlayVoice subtracts one from every nonzero special value before indexing Id_VoiceGroup, so each named selector addresses one distinct special-damage slot.

RESTRAINT has a direct source caller in the throwing restraint action. THUNDER, ASSAULT, TRAP, HAIRPIN and SPEED_DOWN appear in exported damage rows, while the remaining named selectors are declared and dispatched generically without a traced assignment.
